decisions.reason: As a flagship product line closely built on the firm's established waterproof and safety shoe knowledge, the firm can readily interpret early results and improve it, so a drop is unlikely.

The electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe extends existing footwear competence, allowing the firm to assimilate market feedback and refine the product, so keeping it aligns with absorptive capacity.
This safety shoe series leverages the firm's core knowledge and in-house R&D, enabling learning and adaptation, so management would retain it rather than drop it.
